Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP status & next steps (GreenWave pilot) — new sponsor intro

Hi Rishi / Marissa —

Thanks for the intro, Asha — happy to take point. Apologies for the org churn; we’ve got procurement + clinical ops pulled in now and want to move deliberately. To get us unstuck I’d like to re-kick the MAP with clear milestones and owners. Proposed high-level timeline below:

- Week 1 (Feb 23–27): Security deep-dive + vendor questionnaire (Redwood to provide SOC2 artifacts, data flow diagrams)
- Week 2 (Mar 2–6): Pilot scope & test dataset prep (GreenWave legal to sign NDA if needed)
- Week 4 (Mar 16–20): Pilot execution (2-week smoke test)
- Week 7 (Apr 6–10): Procurement approvals / PO issuance
- Target go-live window: Late April

Can you update the MAP to reflect those milestones and owners? Also copying Sara Lim (procurement) — Sara, can you confirm target PO timeline if pilot results look good?

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Barnes
Product Lead, Clinical Systems
GreenWave Health
michael.barnes@greenwave.health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@greenwave.health>, Asha Varma <asha.varma@greenwave.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@greenwave.health>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP restart — updated plan + next meeting

Michael / team —

Appreciate the clear timeline. I’ve updated the MAP to match your milestones and assigned owners where we have them mapped on our side. Summary of changes:

- Security deep-dive (Week 1): Marissa will run the session and share SOC2 + data flow slides in advance.
- Pilot scope (Week 2): Rishi (me) + Michael to finalize dataset and acceptance criteria.
- Pilot execution (Weeks 4–5): Redwood to provide a dedicated eval endpoint; we’ll include a token/usage cap for the smoke test.
- Procurement (Week 7): Vivek to support commercial checklist and draft SOW language; Sara to confirm internal PO timeline.

I’ve attached the updated MAP (greenwave_map_v2.xlsx) and a short eval plan PDF. Proposed next step: 30-min re-kick on Mon, Feb 23 at 10:00am PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda (security, acceptance criteria, procurement path).

Attachments: greenwave_map_v2.xlsx, redwood_eval_plan.pdf

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
